up: Retrieve all distinct compounds that are mentioned in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5728629. For each compound, provide its ChEMBL identifier, its preferred name, and its canonical SMILES (if available). To accomplish this, identify the document in the docs table, then use the compound_records table to find compounds associated with that document, and then look up the molecule details in molecule_dictionary and compound_structures.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id,
    md.pref_name,
    cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728629';
